scope.description:
`run` is the P3-04 namespace; `subject` is reserved for the
long-term-memory slot and requires trusted subject evidence.

resourceVersionId.description:
Versioned resources carry their exact UUID. Fixed dependencies such as
Vault-backed credentials intentionally carry no resource version.

Exact UUID for immutable versions; `None` represents a fixed
dependency such as a Vault-backed credential.

CompiledExitV1.description: Per-exit mapping of global contract fields to dynamic values.

CompiledLoopBodyV1.description:
Container execution contract for `loop_over_items`: the machine fans each
input item into one activation round of the body sub-DAG (distinct
generation per iteration) and aggregates the body sinks back into an
ordered array on the loop node's `main` output.

container.description: Definition id of the container node this node lives in (loop body).

routesError.description:
True when the node has at least one outgoing `error` edge: a failed
attempt then emits an error item on that branch instead of failing the
workflow ("wiring is the policy").

targetExit.description: Exit node id this terminal connection delivers through.

exitOrder.description:
Enabled Exit ids in their original Definition order. Runtime result
materialization must use this list instead of map-key ordering.

exits.description:
Exit nodes keyed by node id. Terminal materialization picks the exit
that actually received the delivery.

startToExit.description: Exit node id when Start connects straight to an exit.

cardinalities.description: Frozen per-port item cardinality from the published Node Manifest.

portSchemas.description: Frozen per-port JSON Schemas after applying node-instance projections.

InputBinding.description:
The only public value language accepted by Workflow Definition 8.0.

Input bindings deliberately contain no calculation node. Arrays and objects
are recursive so structured JSON may embed stable references and text
templates without falling back to a second expression protocol.

ReferenceBinding.description: Reference-only parameters such as List input and Loop input/output.

capabilities.description:
Modalities the deployment accepts as native model input
(plan7 P7-B); absent means text-only so old bundles stay valid.

WebhookReplyConfigV1.description:
Channel auto-reply configuration (plan7 P7-A L1): frozen into the trigger
revision alongside the rest of the channel configuration; the runtime
delivery loop enqueues an outbound reply when the execution reaches a
terminal state.

outputField.description:
Name of the workflow output field whose value is replied (required
when enabled; Control validates it against the deployment output
schema before freezing).

template.description:
Optional template over the output; only output-field variables are
allowed. When empty the raw output field value is replied as text.

WorkflowCompletion.description:
How the engine finalizes an execution whose branches reach exit nodes.

- `FirstReturn` (default): the first delivery to reach an exit (main or
  error port, symmetric) finalizes the execution immediately and cancels
  every other in-flight activation.
- `AllComplete`: the execution waits for quiescence; every reached exit is
  evaluated against the shared `end.outputs` contract and each output field
  is returned as an array with one element per reached exit (definition
  order; unreached exits and unbound fields are omitted).

WorkflowOutput.description:
The global output contract shared by every exit node. Field values are
mapped per exit in [`ExitParameters`], never here.
